Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
As of today (14 November 2026), has the time limit within which the Commission must draw up the report on the delegation of power under Article 47(2) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 already expired?

response.text: Has the deadline by which the Commission must prepare the report on the delegation of power under Article 47(2) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 already passed as of today, 14 November 2026?
